title: Template-Search Domain Adaptation via Multi-Stage Feature Alignment for Cross-Modal Object Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2609.38637v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual object tracking typically assumes that the initial template and subsequent search frames share the same sensing modality. In practice, sensor availability or operation may change over time, creating a substantial representation gap between template and search frames. Unlike conventional multi-modal tracking where paired modalities are simultaneously available, cross-modal tracking requires localization when template and search frames originate from different active modalities. Accordingly, we introduce TSDA-Track, a Template-Search Domain Adaptation framework to reduce modality discrepancy during training. We investigate two feature alignment strategies. Pre-AFA TSDA-Track applies adversarial alignment before transformer's template-search interaction to suppress modality-specific bias. translated_title: 基于多阶段特征对齐的模板-搜索域自适应跨模态目标跟踪
translated_abstract: 视觉目标跟踪通常假设初始模板帧和后续搜索帧共享相同的传感模态。但在实际应用中，传感器的可用性或工作状态可能随时间变化，导致模板与搜索帧之间产生显著的表示差异。与传统的多模态跟踪（即配对模态同时可用）不同，跨模态跟踪要求在模板帧和搜索帧来自不同活动模态的情况下完成目标定位。为此，我们提出了TSDA-Track，一个模板-搜索域自适应框架，用于在训练过程中减小模态间的差异。我们研究了两种特征对齐策略：Pre-AFA TSDA-Track在Transformer进行模板-搜索交互之前应用对抗对齐，以抑制模态特定的偏差；Enc-CFA TSDA-Track在交互之后对编码器表示应用对比对齐，以增强目标级别的跨模态对应关系。
tldr: 该论文提出TSDA-Track跨模态目标跟踪框架，通过在Transformer模板-搜索交互前进行对抗对齐、交互后进行对比对齐的多阶段特征对齐策略，有效缩小模板帧与搜索帧来自不同传感模态时的域差异。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TSDA-Track, a template-search domain adaptation framework for cross-modal object tracking that reduces the modality gap between template and search frames through multi-stage feature alignment, applying adversarial alignment before and contrastive alignment after the transformer's template-search interaction.
